description: Machine-readable inventory of bundle-and-build audit checks for validation and generated maps.

statusTaxonomy.present: The expected invariant is fully satisfied.
statusTaxonomy.partial: Most signals resolve, with a small number of exceptions, or a stats-required check runs without stats input.
statusTaxonomy.violation: Concrete configuration or output breaks the invariant.

enrichmentFlags.description: Consume a build-stats file so size and build-time checks can measure real output instead of degrading to partial.

relatedAudits.relationship: Owns runtime and rendering cost; this audit owns build output and bundle size.
Owns dependency health; duplicate-package detection overlaps.

checks.title: Build tool present and pinned
checks.expectation: A build tool is installed and its version is pinned in package.json.
checks.violationSignal: The build tool is missing, or pinned with a caret or tilde range.

checks.title: Browserslist explicit
checks.expectation: A browserslist field exists in package.json, or a .browserslistrc file is present.
checks.violationSignal: No browserslist configuration anywhere.

checks.title: Production mode enforced
checks.expectation: The build script invokes the framework's production-build command and continuous integration runs it with NODE_ENV=production.
checks.violationSignal: NODE_ENV is not set, or the build script invokes a development command.

checks.title: Source maps configured deliberately
checks.expectation: Production builds emit source maps in an explicitly chosen mode.
checks.violationSignal: No source-map configuration whatsoever; the build tool's default is silently in use.

checks.title: Build output ignored from git
checks.expectation: The build output directory is in .gitignore.
checks.violationSignal: Build output is committed or not ignored.

checks.title: Production dependencies separated
checks.expectation: No development-only packages appear in dependencies.
checks.violationSignal: Development packages in dependencies.

checks.title: Deterministic build
checks.expectation: The build script does not depend on environment-specific flags or interactive input.
checks.violationSignal: Scripts containing --watch, interactive prompts, or non-deterministic timestamps in output filenames.

checks.title: Initial bundle size budget
checks.expectation: The initial JavaScript payload is under the threshold.
checks.violationSignal: The initial payload exceeds the threshold.

checks.title: Total bundle size budget
checks.expectation: The full client-side JavaScript payload across all chunks is under the threshold.
checks.violationSignal: The total exceeds the threshold.

checks.title: Route-level code splitting
checks.expectation: The build splits per route or per page.
checks.violationSignal: Single-bundle output, or the framework's automatic route-splitting has been turned off.

checks.title: No duplicate dependencies
checks.expectation: Each dependency appears exactly once in the bundle.
checks.violationSignal: Multiple copies detected in stats, or multiple incompatible major versions in the lockfile.

checks.title: Large-library hygiene
checks.expectation: Large libraries are imported with named imports or per-method paths so tree-shaking can remove what is unused.
checks.violationSignal: Namespace or default imports of large libraries in source.

checks.title: Dynamic imports for heavy features
checks.expectation: Heavy non-critical features are loaded with React.lazy or framework-equivalent dynamic imports.
checks.violationSignal: Heavy libraries imported synchronously at the top level of an entry-reachable module.

checks.title: No development-only code in production
checks.expectation: No unguarded console.log, DevTools shim, or debug-only code path is reachable in production builds.
checks.violationSignal: Such patterns present without an environment guard, or detected in built output when stats are available.

checks.title: Image optimisation
checks.expectation: Images use modern formats where the framework supports them, and the framework's image primitive is used.
checks.violationSignal: Multi-megabyte PNGs or JPEGs in public assets, or a framework project not using its image primitive for content imagery.

checks.title: Font handling
checks.expectation: Fonts are subset, self-hosted or served with font-display: swap, and preloaded for above-the-fold text.
checks.violationSignal: Loading entire web-font families with no font-display, or sourcing fonts from a script-blocking external host.

checks.title: CSS extraction
checks.expectation: CSS is extracted into separate files in production builds, except above-the-fold critical CSS.
checks.violationSignal: A CSS-in-JS configuration that ships styles inside JS chunks unconditionally without extraction.

checks.title: Static assets cacheable
checks.expectation: Build output produces hashed filenames so long-cache headers can be set safely.
checks.violationSignal: Filenames without content hashes.

checks.title: No vendored dependencies
checks.expectation: No copies of third-party packages live under src/ or vendor/.
checks.violationSignal: Files matching the signature of a known package present in src/.

checks.title: sideEffects field declared
checks.expectation: package.json declares a sideEffects field so tree-shaking can remove unused exports.
checks.violationSignal: The sideEffects field is absent.

checks.title: Bundle analyser available
checks.expectation: A bundle-analysis tool is installed and runnable.
checks.violationSignal: No bundle-analysis tool present.

checks.title: Build cache enabled
checks.expectation: The build tool's cache is enabled.
checks.violationSignal: The cache is disabled or configured to a discarded location.

checks.title: TypeScript incremental mode
checks.expectation: tsconfig.json has incremental: true, or the project uses composite project references.
checks.violationSignal: Neither is enabled.

checks.title: Continuous-integration cache
checks.expectation: The continuous-integration workflow caches the package-manager store and the build cache between runs.
checks.violationSignal: No cache step, or a cache key not derived from the lockfile hash.

checks.title: Bundle-size budget enforced in continuous integration
checks.expectation: A bundle-size check runs in continuous integration and fails the build when the budget is exceeded.
checks.violationSignal: No such step detected.

checks.title: Build-time budget
checks.expectation: Reported clean-build and incremental-rebuild times are under their thresholds.
checks.violationSignal: Measurements exceed the thresholds.
